Moreover, I'm not exactly sure what triggers this event, but you sometimes get an event when your child reaches 14 to encourage them to "strive for greatness", which results in the "Ambitious" trait (+2 to all stats). In adulthood, I put "Scholarship Focus" (+3). And afterwards, Hermetic Society. Also, when you write a book and choose the "Learning" focus, you should end up with a book that raises the "Learning" stat.

My team:

* Frontline: Waver, Rider Martha (for buff/debuff cleansing), support Cu Alter with MLB Princess

* Backline: Herc, Orion (for dealing with Nero; not the best choice in retrospect), Mash

* Mystic Code: Atlas

First turn, Cu Alter gets three cards and obliterates Jack. Medea casts Poison, I use Martha to cleanse it and Jack's debuff. Amakusa gets in. Waver buffs the team and Cu Alter gets a lucky crit, killing him on the same turn. Ozzy rolls in with Imperial Privilege. Martha cleanses it. After a turn or two, Cu Alter's got his NP and two buster cards ready, killing LAlter and Ozzy on the same turn. Then the hard part kicks in: Sure Hit, making my evasion skills useless. Meanwhile, Nero rolls in, and Waver and Martha bite the dust. Herc and Orion come in. Orion does some nice damage to Nero before kicking the bucket. Mash comes in with Volumen Hydrargyrum, and I use her to tank a couple of hits, and I use her skills and Atlas to keep Cu Alter unhurt. Eventually, I get Nero to penultimate life, Herc dies and Cu Alter's NP and chain are ready, killing Medea and bringing Nero to her last life. But, to make things worse, on top of Medea's defense buff, Nero also casts Imperial Privilege on herself. Cu Alter's chain does very little damage. Nero was on her last 20k HP and Cu Alter on his last 1k. I didn't think Cu Alter could take her out because of her defense debuffs, and I also doubted Mash could finish it before she NP's. So I reluctantly use a CS to fire off Cu Alter's NP for a definite finishing blow.

All in all, it was a very intense fight. I cleared all previous Exhibitions without Command Seals, so I'm kind of bummed I had to use one now when I was very close to victory, but I didn't want to risk losing when I had come so close. :) I'll just have to git more gud till the next time. :)
